tasks.subject: Task 1: Gate full-mode cross-validation on --validate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `--validate` controls whether cross-validation runs in step 6, matching its documented behavior and step 5's existing gating.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/src/main.rs` — `validation_config` (~line 192) and its call site in `run_calibration` (~line 567)
- Modify: `calibrate/src/main.rs` — `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` at end of file

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- validation_config takes `validate: bool` and sets `num_folds` to 0 when false
- With --validate, num_folds is args.cv_folds (unchanged)
- Non-CV validation output unaffected in both cases
- Existing main.rs tests updated for the 3-arg signature and passing

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --bin calibrate` → 4 tests pass

**Steps:** Add the two failing tests; run (compile error, 2 args vs 3); change signature and gate num_folds; update call site to pass args.validate; update the two existing tests; run; fmt and commit.

Background: --validate is documented "Run cross-validation after fitting". Step 5 honors it; step 6 did not, so --cv-folds' clap default of 5 meant every full-mode run cross-validated. Only CV is gated.


tasks.subject: Task 2: Deterministic perturbed-truth fixture generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A test-support module that writes a measurement CSV containing known-truth data — generated from the real physics model with a perturbed surface RMS plus a closed-form injected bias — and exposes the injected truth so tests can assert recovery.

**Files:**
- Create: `calibrate/tests/support/mod.rs`
- Create: `calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs` (generator self-tests only at this stage)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Two generate_rows runs produce byte-identical CSV
- >= 200 rows so a 5-fold CV split clears the 125-point minimum
- Spans exceed knot floors: >= 200 MHz, >= 12 deg cone, >= 40 deg clock
- >= 20% of rows below -20 dB/K (D11 pin)
- Injected truth exported as named constants

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e -- --nocapture` → 4 tests pass

**Steps:** Write support/mod.rs (UHF_Array_Element, nominal RMS 2.0 mm, perturbed 2.6 mm, T=100 K, bias coefficients, grid constants, injected_bias_db, fixture_config, generate_rows, rows_to_csv, write_fixture_csv); write the 4 self-tests; run — if the sub-minus-20 test fails EXTEND the cone grid, do NOT lower the threshold; fmt and commit.

Only surface_rms_mm is perturbed — full-mode TunableParameters has no q_factor. fixture_config must mirror main.rs::compute_model_predictions exactly.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["calibrate/tests/support/mod.rs", "calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e -- --nocapture", "acceptanceCriteria": ["two generate_rows runs produce byte-identical CSV", ">=200 rows", "freq span >=200MHz, cone >=12deg, clock >=40deg", ">=20% of rows below -20 dB/K", "injected truth exported as named constants"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: CLI end-to-end run and artifact assertions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run the actual `calibrate` binary over the fixture and assert it exits 0, writes a service-loadable artifact, and improves on the uncorrected model.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs`
- Modify: `calibrate/Cargo.toml` — add `serde_json = "1.0.150"` to [dev-dependencies]

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Invokes env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_calibrate"), not a library function
- Exit success; prints captured stdout+stderr on failure
- Artifact begins with ASCII magic ANTC
- antenna_model::data::loader::load_calibration_artifact loads it
- antenna_id == "d12_uhf_test" and correction_surface.is_some()
- --report sidecar shows corrected_rmse < model_only_rmse (and < half)

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e cli_ -- --nocapture` → passes well under 60 s

**Steps:** Add serde_json dev-dep; write CalibrateRun + run_calibrate helper and the two tests; run — likely failures are (a) class not found → --classes-file path, build from CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR, (b) insufficient data → check the "Parsed N measurements" line; fmt and commit.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Known-answer recovery and cross-validation assertions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Assert the correction surface recovers the injected bias at probe points, and that --validate / --cv-folds behave as D10 and Task 1 established.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Correction at interior probes tracks injected_bias_db within BIAS_RECOVERY_TOLERANCE_DB (start 0.35 dB)
- Probe points interior to the grid
- --validate --cv-folds N gives num_folds == N and N fold RMSEs, N in {3,6}
- Without --validate: null cross_validation AND no CV announcement in output
- Without --validate the rest of step 6 is still present
- Tolerance documented with its reason

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e -- --nocapture` → all pass

**Steps:** Add the recovery test with 4 interior probes — API traps: evaluate_correction params are named azimuth/elevation but map clock→azimuth, cone→elevation, pass CLOCK first, and it returns CorrectionResult so take .correction_db. Add the two CV tests. Run and read per-probe errors: slightly >0.35 dB → raise and document the measured value; >~1 dB → STOP and investigate; ~0 correction → surface fitted nothing. Do NOT widen past ~1 dB. check.sh and commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e -- --nocapture", "acceptanceCriteria": ["correction tracks injected_bias_db within documented tolerance at interior probes", "--cv-folds N yields num_folds==N and N fold RMSEs for N in {3,6}", "no cross_validation section and no CV announcement without --validate", "corrected_rmse/main_lobe_max_error/first_sidelobe_max_error still present without --validate", "tolerance documented with its reason"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Measure the tuned run and decide its CI status
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Determine empirically whether an end-to-end run with --tune-parameters is affordable in CI, and either include it or mark it #[ignore] with the measured justification.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A tuned end-to-end run exists and passes
- Wall-clock time measured and recorded in the doc comment
- #[ignore]d with measured time + run command if >~60 s; enabled otherwise
- Asserts tuned surface_rms_mm > nominal 2.0 mm
- --metadata sidecar shows parameters_tuned == true

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e tuned -- --nocapture --include-ignored`

**Steps:** Add the tuned test with --max-tuning-iterations 8 and Instant timing. Read RMS as calibration.physical_config.reflector.surface_rms_mm — data layer stores MILLIMETRES (types.rs:362), unlike the model-layer builder which takes metres; a value near 0.002 means the wrong unit. Measure; decide (prefer an enabled fast version, but if the directional assertion fails at low iterations keep the count and ignore it — do NOT weaken the assertion). check.sh and commit.

Cost model: DE evaluates the model at all 288 points per candidate (~0.4 s debug), so cost is iterations x population x points. Sequenced last so everything before it ships regardless.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e tuned -- --nocapture --include-ignored", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tuned end-to-end run exists and passes", "wall-clock time measured and recorded in the doc comment", "ignored with measured justification if >~60s, enabled otherwise", "asserts tuned surface_rms_mm > nominal 2.0mm", "metadata sidecar shows parameters_tuned true"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
